messages:
maria: quick ping — can someone take a look at PR #1287? It's the rest client unification (Helpers -> Uniface) plus streaming hooks for tool-calling. hoping to merge by EOD if there are no blockers. link: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/1287 :pray:
kevin: on my list, will try to review in the next hour. any breaking public API changes i should watch for?
sophie: curious about python wrapper changes — will this require consumers to update imports?
maria: good q. short answer: yes for import path in 1 spot (helpers -> uniface). added a tiny migration note in the PR description and a compat shim for one release. exact line: `from redwood.client.helpers import X` becomes `from redwood.client.uniface import X`
raj: i can run an integration smoke against dedicated infra after approvals. will need the test branch name.
maria: branch is feat/uniface-rest-1287. smoke test checklist in PR: auth flows, streaming reconnect, tool_call schema validation.
kevin: quick glance at client.kt — looks clean. one nit: rename param `enableStreaming` -> `streamingEnabled` for consistency with other flags. small change, but prefer it for readability.
sophie: saw the python tests failing locally for me on windows with the new import path. maria, can you add the shim import at top-level package to avoid immediate break for some users?
maria: yes i already added a compat shim in `redwood/client/__init__.py` that re-exports old name. pushed a follow-up commit.
ci-bot: build/pytest — feat/uniface-rest-1287 — 1754123499 — Tests: running
devx-bot: lint/checks — feat/uniface-rest-1287 — 1754123505 — Found 1 lint warning in python client (unused import), fix pushed?
kevin: approved from my side after param rename. left an approve on github. :white_check_mark:
raj: running smoke tests now against staging-dedicated (region us-west-2). will post results in ~10m.
ci-bot: build/pytest — feat/uniface-rest-1287 — 1754123550 — All tests passed (unit + integration)
devx-bot: e2e — feat/uniface-rest-1287 — 1754123558 — Streaming e2e flaky on reconnect test, rerunning
sophie: i can re-run the failing e2e locally too, will try to reproduce.
maria: thanks all. if CI is green and no other objections, i'll merge after raj's smoke confirmation. tagging @kevin @sophie for final thumbs. :thumbsup:
raj: smoke tests passed. streaming reconnect looked stable on 1000 msgs, no errors.
maria: merging now. will cut a short changelog entry and bump client minor in the release notes. thanks everyone. :rocket:
